You have a type mismatch. The value on one side doesn't match the type on the other side. Check that your variable types match what you're assigning or passing to them.

patterns.regex: reached end of file while parsing
patterns.explanation: Java reached the end of your file but was still expecting more code. This almost always means you opened a curly brace '{' or parenthesis '(' somewhere but never closed it with '}' or ')'. Count your opening and closing braces — they must match!

patterns.regex: variable ([a-zA-Z0-9_]+) might not have been initialized
patterns.explanation: You're trying to use the variable '{}' before giving it a value. Java doesn't allow reading a variable that might not have been set yet. Give it a starting value when you declare it, like: 'int {} = 0;'
